## About this product

Jot down scores with this 144-pack of Dixon 3.5-inch #2 soft presharpened golf pencils.

Stock up on these versatile golf pencils. These small presharpened pencils are great for children, church pews, survey forms and other group activities. The #2 soft pencil lead makes it easy to sharpen. These Dixon golf pencils are PMA certified nontoxic, so they are safe to use.

Ready to Use Dixon presharpened #2 golf pencils are ready to use right out of the box. The presharpened points eliminate the need for a pencil sharpener when you grab a new pencil. This can shave key seconds or minutes off the time you need to write down information or sports scores.

Versatile This set of golf pencils fits neatly in golf bags and briefcases as well as in office drawers. The small size of each pencil allows you to keep it in a binder or pocket until needed. The versatile pencils are also great for newspaper crosswords and other diversions.

Bulk Quantity Dixon presharpened #2 golf pencils sets give you 144 separate writing utensils. Keep them on hand for large golf tournaments, busy offices, or other gatherings where each attendant may desire their own pencil. The pencils are also a great choice for elections and bingo games.

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 12.79 USD.

Top review: I think these are great; I don’t have to waste a whole pencil on students who will usually not return them when finished. My students do not care for these due to the short stature and no eraser. Well, I’m short of stature, but full of knowledge to train them in skills, so don’t judge. It still fits their hands without the extended tail waving around that will end up in the parking lot or trash at the end of the day. Also, in high school, you don’t need an eraser in English. You need editing symbols. While I prefer pens, these work great and when they wander away and don’t come back, I still have plenty left and don’t feel sad about the cost. I just imagine that these little pencils end up assisting them in math.

Top review: These pencils were just what I was looking for, a large quantity for a low price- this way I don't mind if they walk away. Also after a couple sharpens, they are shorter and then require students to use the intrinsic muscles in their hand to write- this helps to strengthen the students hands. I would love them more if they had something on one end of the pencil so that the students don't sharpen both ends, but then again eraser caps can help solve this problem and give a cleaner erase. I also like that they came pre-sharpened! However, it is a good idea to invest in a handheld sharpener, they become hard to hold or stuck in electric sharpeners. There are plenty of pencils in this box any I would happily order them again when I run out of them.
